answer: To raise the cost of sybil swarms, require every identity that wants to attest or vote to lock a slashable bond in a time-gated vault. A hollow sockpuppet can be created for free, but it cannot enter consensus until that bond is posted and held through a probation window. Only after unrelated peers witness distinct work does the identity join the island of accounts with nonzero weight. An attacker who wants a thousand votes must lock a thousand independent bonds and wait out a thousand clocks, so influence scales with capital and time, not with account minting.
